about.title: About the Expedition Base Set set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Expedition Base Set is a e-Card expansion released on 15 September 2002. It has 165 cards: 165 in the main set and 0 secret rares. There are also 159 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 165 main set cards) or the Master set (324 cards, adding the reverse holos).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
